title: Merge base reasoning
prompt: Implement `static string? CommonAncestor(Dictionary<string, string> parent, string a, string b)` — the nearest commit both a and b descend from (null when no shared ancestor).

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: Walk both lines to the deepest shared node.

tests.name: unrelated
tests.hint: Disconnected histories have no ancestor; a commit contains itself.
